parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
The level of the rule.

For threat detection (risk) and security events (event), valid values are:

- **high**: important

- **medium**: medium

- **low**: low

For sensitive data (sensitive\_word), valid values are:

- **S1**: S1

- **S2**: S2

- **S3**: S3

- **S4**: S4

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description:
The source of the rule. Valid values:

- **custom**: custom

- **default**: built-in

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The enabling status of the rule. Valid values:

- **1**: enabled

- **0**: disabled

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the rule. Valid values:

- **risk**: threat detection

- **event**: security event

- **sensitive\_word**: sensitive data

- **auth\_flag**: authentication credential

- **api\_tag**: business purpose

- **desensitization**: data masking

- **whitelist**: whitelist

- **recognition**: API

- **offline\_api**: lifecycle management
